name: Sanitz (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sanitz (a crozier, a key and a hare between flowers on green).
history: The arms were designed by the Schwerin heraldist Karl-Heinz Steinbruch; the flag is evenly striped lengthwise in green, white and green.

features.role: Sanitz arms — crozier, key and hare on green
